title: Brown tells Josh Reynolds the Philadelphia Experiment was inflated

tellings.quote: After all, Brown actually told his friend Josh Reynolds, who worked closely with him, that the Philadelphia Experiment book and later movie were greatly inflated.

plain: The Philadelphia Experiment is a tale of a secret Navy test in Philadelphia in 1943 that later became a book and a movie, and according to Michels, the researcher Thomas Townsend Brown told his friend and close co-worker Josh Reynolds that both were 'greatly inflated'. Michels passes this on as what Reynolds was told, and it matters because it would mean someone said to be close to the events played the legend down.
